newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-ITALY SQUAD FOR WALES AND IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY SQUAD FOR WALES AND IRELAND.

text.p: Italy on Wednesday named a 25-man squad for two rugby union matches against Welsh clubs later this month and an international against Ireland on January 4.
Italy play Caerphilly on December 29 and Llanelli on December 31, before the Lansdowne Road clash.

Squad: Andrea Castellani, Carlo Checchinato, Walter Cristofoletto, Mauro dal Sie, Ivan Francescato, Julian Gardner, Andrea Gritti, Leandro Manteri, Francesco Mazzariol, Alessandro Moscardi, Andrea Sgorlon, Alessandro Troncon, Orazio Arancio, Giambattista Croci, Marcello Cuttitta, Massimo Cuttitta, Diego Dominguez, Massimo Giovanelli, Carlo Orlandi, Cristian Stoica, Stefano Bordon, Gianluca Guidi, Nicola Mazzucato, Javier Pertile, Paolo Vaccari.
